notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44057155/3c9f64aa6491971ded7624b19457f9d334a4b0fe.png[/img]

[b]Good news to all players![/b]

We have just launched a game update!

In this version, we are introducing the following changes:
[list]
[*] Korean language support
[*] Japanese language support
[*] New main menu interface
[/list]

We hope you all enjoy it.
